publisher.value: HL7 International - Public Health Work Group

description.value: The decedent whose death is being notified, carrying the demographics a receiving system needs in order to match the notification to an existing patient record. This profile derives from the VRDR Decedent (and therefore from VRCL Patient and US Core Patient) and adds must-support obligations on the elements that carry matching value. It does not define a matching algorithm; how a receiver matches, and what identity assurance it requires of the sender, are out of scope for this guide.

human.value: A decedent SHALL carry either a Social Security Number, or a birth date together with an address or a telecom, so that a receiving system has enough demographic breadth to match safely.

expression.value: identifier.where(type.coding.where(system = 'http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/v2-0203' and code = 'SS').exists()).exists() or (birthDate.exists() and (address.exists() or telecom.exists()))

short.value: Identifiers for the decedent, including the SSN and any medical record number known to the sender
Medical record number, if the sender happens to hold one for the receiving system
Social Security Number, the single highest-value matching element when available
Maiden name, which materially improves matching for decedents whose name changed after their record was created
SHALL be true. The date and time of death are carried by the Fact of Death Death Date observation, which is the authoritative source for them.
Residence address of the decedent, used for matching
